title: Hua Tuo Scrapes the Bone; Lü Meng Crosses the River in White
summary: The arrow wound is poisoned to the bone. Hua Tuo proposes to cut it open and scrape the bone clean, and Guan Yu declines the ropes and the post, plays a board game through the operation, and drinks and jokes while the blade grates.

Downriver, Lü Meng announces an illness and hands over to the young and harmless-seeming Lu Xun, who writes Guan Yu a flattering letter. The Jing garrisons are thinned to reinforce Fancheng — and Wu's soldiers come up the river dressed as white-robed merchants, take the beacon towers without a signal being lit, and Jing province falls without a battle.
history: The bone-scraping is in the histories, although Hua Tuo was dead by then. The white-clothed crossing is historical and is the most elegant operation of the entire war.

pins.note: Plays a board game while his bone is scraped.
Offers no ropes, and is not asked for any.
Takes the province dressed as a merchant.
Writes a flattering letter, and is believed.
